Make the gift feel like them

For a child’s birthday
Start with one thing they love doing. A football-mad seven-year-old could discover that someone has replaced the match ball with a dragon’s egg.
For a big birthday
Give their favourite family story a new ending. For a fortieth, try the camping disaster everyone remembers, this time told by the person who forgot the tent.
For their keepsake shelf
Add who the gift is from and a short dedication. Try “For your seventh birthday, from Gran. May you always ask what’s round the next corner.”

Price and birthday delivery

What will the book cost?
With £3.99 UK postage, the A5 hardback is £28.98 delivered (£24.99 for the book). The larger A4 hardback is £33.98 delivered (£29.99 for the book).
What can I see before I buy?
The free preview shows their illustrated character, cover and opening pages. You can change the words before deciding whether to order.
When should I order?
Your full illustrated proof is ready within seven calendar days of payment. After you approve it, printing and UK delivery usually take another 7 to 12 working days. Allow extra time for changes. See ordering and delivery.

Who’s celebrating?

A photo, a name and one birthday wish are enough to get started. You can make their preview without a payment card.
